functions.name: orchestrate
functions.title: Orchestrate via Prime Eden Skye
functions.description: Send a message to Prime Eden Skye (PRIMUS), the primary orchestrator of Vision Cortex V-1. It decides whether to handle directly or delegate to specialist agents, synthesizes a unified response, and runs it through the Validator. Use this as the main entry point for any decision, analysis, or action request to the brain.

message.description: The message or request to orchestrate

functions.name: simulate
functions.title: Run Multi-Scenario Simulation
functions.description: Run a predictive multi-scenario simulation (best, base, worst case) on any topic with probabilities, financial impact, timeline, risks, opportunities, and a recommendation.

topic.description: The topic or decision to simulate

functions.name: analyze_portfolio
functions.title: Analyze System Portfolio
functions.description: Run a deep system analysis across the entire Vision Cortex portfolio — scans entities, agents, gaps, simulations, and life plans, then identifies the top enhancement opportunities with web-searched technical protocols. No input required.

functions.name: sweep_opportunities
functions.title: Sweep for Opportunities
functions.description: Search the internet for people requesting tech services (websites, apps, AI, automation, scraping) across Craigslist, Reddit, LinkedIn, Upwork, and forums. Returns new opportunities with contact info and relevance scores.

max_queries.description: Number of search queries to run, 1-8, defaults to 5

query_offset.description: Offset for rotating through search queries, defaults to 0

functions.name: extract_intel
functions.title: Extract Intel from URL
functions.description: Scrape a URL via the cloud browser and extract structured intelligence signals into the IntelFeed. Returns headlines, summaries, key takeaways, correlations, and impact scores.

url.description: The URL to scrape and analyze

prompt.description: Custom extraction prompt, optional — uses default if omitted

category.description: Category label for the intel, optional

functions.name: covert_browse
functions.title: Covert Browse URL
functions.description: Covertly browse a URL via the cloud browser — traceless, nothing persisted. Returns raw page text or an LLM-structured extraction based on a custom prompt.

prompt.description: Optional LLM extraction prompt — if omitted with extract=false, returns raw page text

extract.description: If true, run LLM extraction with the prompt; if false or omitted, return raw text

functions.name: dispatch_build
functions.title: Dispatch Idea to Builder
functions.description: Dispatch an approved Idea from Vision Cortex (the brain) to the Xtreme AI v2 builder (the hands). The builder creates an AutoBuild record and runs the full pipeline: architecture, data model, UI, code, deploy.

idea_id.description: The ID of the approved Idea to dispatch

auto_advance.description: Whether the builder should auto-advance through pipeline steps, defaults to true

functions.name: gather_intelligence
functions.title: Gather Intelligence on Topic
functions.description: Run free-tier autonomous intelligence research on a KnowledgeQuest using DuckDuckGo search, Wikipedia, and web page fetching, then synthesize via Groq LLM. Updates the quest with a full researched answer, sources, and perspectives.

quest_id.description: The ID of the KnowledgeQuest to research

mode.description: Set to 'next_pending' to auto-pick the next pending quest by priority

functions.name: run_master_cycle
functions.title: Run Master Autonomous Cycle
functions.description: Trigger the full 6-phase autonomous loop across ALL managed systems: audit (live-fetch all sites + read internal systems), analyze (identify top priorities), fix (create enhancement tickets), heal (update scores + create healing actions), harden (security recommendations), optimize (push toward 100). Runs on free Groq LLM. No input required.

functions.name: system_sync
functions.title: Bi-Directional System Sync
functions.description: Bi-directional sync endpoint for connected systems. Actions: 'status' (get all system/site health scores), 'instructions' (pull pending enhancement tickets for a specific system), 'report' (mark an enhancement as implemented/failed), 'register' (register a new site to be monitored), 'heartbeat' (ping). Other apps use this to stay in sync with Vision Cortex — pull their instructions, report implementations, and check their scores.

system_name.description: For 'instructions' action: the name of your system to pull pending enhancements for

enhancement_id.description: For 'report' action: the ID of the enhancement to update

notes.description: For 'report' action: implementation notes or failure reason
